text: The National Sports Club of Assam (Taking-Over Management) 1978 (Act No.9 of 1978) Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 19789 Act Number: 9 Enactment Date: 1978-08-09 Act Year: 1978 Short Title: The National Sports Club of Assam (Taking-Over Management) 1978 (Act No.9 of 1978) Long Title: An Act to provide for the taking-over of the management of the National Sports Club of Assam within the State of Meghalaya from the present Executive Committee and other committees of the Club and from the holders of offices of the Club for a limited period in the public interest and in order to secure the proper management of the Club and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
